Prepare transcriptomic data for Tumor2Line

Source: R/01_data.R
prepare_tumor2line_data.Rd

Standardizes the two expression populations used by Tumor2Line: a query population and a candidate cell-line population. The query population can contain patient tumors, PDOs, PDXs, organoids, or other tumor-derived samples. Known query-cell-line pairs are not required for Tumor2Line matching and are used only for optional downstream evaluation.

Usage

prepare_tumor2line_data(
  query_expr,
  cellline_expr,
  phenotype = NULL,
  sample_id_col = "SampleID",
  pair_col = NULL,
  lineage_col = NULL,
  sample_type_col = NULL,
  query_type = "query",
  cellline_type = "cellline",
  min_mean_tpm = 0.1,
  min_detected_fraction = 0.1
)

Arguments

query_expr

Expression data for the query population. Samples must be rows and genes must be columns. A data frame may contain a sample-ID column; a matrix may use sample IDs as row names.

cellline_expr

Candidate cell-line expression data in the same orientation as `query_expr`.

phenotype

Optional data frame containing sample annotations.

sample_id_col

Name of the sample-ID column in `phenotype`.

pair_col

Optional name of a known pairing column. Set to `NULL` when known query-cell-line pairs are unavailable.

lineage_col

Optional name of the cancer-lineage column. Set to `NULL` when lineage information is unavailable.

sample_type_col

Optional name of a column describing biological sample type, such as tumor, PDO, PDX, organoid, or cell line.

query_type

Default biological label assigned to query samples when `sample_type_col` is unavailable.

cellline_type

Default biological label assigned to candidate cell-line samples when `sample_type_col` is unavailable.

min_mean_tpm

Minimum mean TPM required for a gene to be eligible for variable-gene selection.

min_detected_fraction

Minimum fraction of samples with TPM > 0.

Value

An object of class `Tumor2LineInput` containing standardized metadata, TPM and log-expression matrices, gene statistics, sample IDs and optional known query-cell-line pairs.

Details

Expression matrices are harmonized to shared genes, transformed as log2(TPM + 1), and summarized for variable-gene selection. Sample roles are inferred directly from the two expression matrices rather than phenotype labels.
